name: DCA Lamplight Lounge Weekend Brunch: Indulgent French Toast or Egg-White Frittata Bake & Potatoes
brandOrRestaurant: Lamplight Lounge (Pixar Pier · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: On weekend mornings (Fri–Sun), Lamplight Lounge serves incredible cinnamon-sugar sourdough French Toast and made-to-order egg dishes (or Kids' Scrambled Eggs, Bacon & Toast).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Indulgent French Toast with syrup on the side, or ask for plain Scrambled Eggs with breakfast potatoes, bacon, and sourdough toast (skip chilaquiles and spicy bloody marys).
watchOuts: Avoid the Chilaquiles (fried corn chips + spicy ranchero chili sauce) and Avocado Toast if topped with pickled onions/jalapeños
